# Claritev Corporation Announces Participation in Upcoming Events


**MCLEAN, VA** — November 19, 2026 — Claritev Corporation (“Claritev” or the “Company”) (NYSE: CTEV), a healthcare technology, data, and insights company, today announced that members of its management team will meet with investors at the following events in December 2026:


- *BofA Securities Leveraged Finance Conference* – Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at the Boca Raton Resort and Spa – Presentation at 7:30 a.m. ET and small group meetings
- *Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference* – Thursday, December 3, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace – Fireside chat at 12:00 p.m. ET and one-on-one meetings


A live webcast and audio archive of the events will be available through the investor relations section of Claritev’s website at[https://investors.claritev.com/](https://investors.claritev.com/) . For one-on-one meetings, please contact a representative at the host firms.


## **About Claritev**


Claritev is a healthcare technology, data, and insights company focused on delivering affordability, transparency, and quality across the U.S. healthcare system. Led by deeply experienced associates, data scientists, and innovators, Claritev provides technology-enabled solutions fueled by decades of claims expertise. The company leverages advanced analytics and AI to power a robust enterprise platform that delivers clear, actionable insights to support affordability, price transparency, and optimized network and benefits design. By supporting key stakeholders — including payers, employers, patients, providers, and third parties — Claritev is dedicated to making healthcare more accessible and affordable for all.


Claritev serves more than 750 healthcare payers, over 100,000 employers, 60 million consumers, and 1.4 million contracted providers. For more information, visit[claritev.com](https://www.claritev.com/) .
